name: qr-code
title: QR Code
description: Renders a QR code for a given value, with size variants and an optional center logo overlay.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Rendered centered over the code (logo overlay slot).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value to encode when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the qr code.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: The pixel size of the qr code.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A QR code rendered for a given `value`.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.source: import QrCode from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/qr-code/qr-code.marko";
examples.description: Pass `size` (`sm`, `default`, `lg`) to scale the rendered frame.

examples.title: With center logo overlay
examples.source:
import QrCode from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/qr-code/qr-code.marko"; <@overlay>
UI
examples.description: Fill the `@overlay` slot to place a logo or mark at the center of the code.

examples.title: Download as PNG
examples.description: Pass a ref-like binding (`<QrCode/qrCodeApi>`) to reach the live API and call `getDataUrl` for a downloadable image.

examples.title: Controlled value
examples.source:
import QrCode from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/qr-code/qr-code.marko";

Last valueChange: ${lastValue}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.
